simple.meaning: פֹּעַל (pôʻal) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “an act or work (concretely).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 38 times across Deuteronomy, Ruth, 2 Samuel, 1 Chronicles, Job, and 5 more, beginning at Deuteronomy 32:4. Its contexts include family line, death, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פֹּעַל (H6467).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: פֹּעַל (pôʻal) / H6467 is traced through Deuteronomy 32:4, Deuteronomy 33:11, Ruth 2:12, 2 Samuel 23:20 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H6467. poal מֹּ֫עַל 37 noun masculine Prov 20:11 doing, deed, work (in poetry and late, nearly = מַעֲשֶׂה ); — ׳פ absolute Hab 1:1 ; Psa 44:2 , construct Deut 33:11 +; suffix מָּעֳלוֺ 32:4 +, מֹּעֲלוֺ Isa 1:31 (Kö ii.1, 35, 493 Ges § 93q , see below), Jer 22:13 ; מָּעָלְכֶם Isa 41:24 , etc.; plural מְּעָלִים 2Sam 23:20 ; 1Chr 11:22 ; — 1 deed, thing done: a. of God , מָּעֳלוֺ his work in providence Deut 32:4 ; Isa 5:12 ; Job 36:24 ; in deliverance Psa 44:2 (as accusative of congnate meaning with verb), 77:13 5 t.; in judgment 64:10 ; 95:9 , as accusative of congnate meaning with verb Hab 1:5 . b. of false gods Isa 41:24 . c. of men, daily toil Job 24:5 ; Psa 104:23 ; specific act Ruth 2:12 ; ׳פ יָדָיו of sacrificing Deut 33:11 ; plural of achievements 2Sam 23:20 = 1Chr 11:32 ; action as having moral quality Job 34:11 ; Prov 20:11 ; 24:12 , 29 , evil implied Jer 25:14 ; 50:29 ; Job 36:9 ; Psa 28:4 , ׳פ כַּמָּיו 9:17 ; ׳פ חָמָס Isa 59:6 ; good action Prov 21:8 . 2 work, thing made: a. by hands of God Isa 45:9 , 11 (of men). b. by man Isa 1:31 (i.e. probably his idol Ges Che comm. Di and others; > read בַּעֲלוֺ Lag Semitic i. 5 Sta ZAW iii (1888), 12f. ). 3 wages of work Jer 22:13 ; Job 7:2 . 4 acquisition of treasures Prov 21:6 .
